## About me

Through my work at Cal Poly Pomona, I am developing a foundation in survey research, SQL, BigQuery, R, and reproducible reporting with Quarto. In my Culminating Experience Project (CEP), I contribute to a digital marketing strategy for The Restaurant at Kellogg Ranch. My focus is website content, navigation, and usability: helping prospective guests find dining information and reach the reservation interface.

## Career direction

My current project work points toward customer insights and digital marketing analytics, especially using research to improve online customer experiences. I want to translate business questions into measurable objectives and communicate the evidence behind recommendations.

## Education & applied learning

**Cal Poly Pomona — current coursework**  
Customer Insight Methods and Survey Research (IBM 6500), digital marketing analytics, and the MSDM Culminating Experience Project.
